limitations.note: Replacing the enable ternaries with procedural `if` guards changes four-state simulation behavior: an X or Z enable now holds the prior value instead of merging it with the candidate value.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted. Use a safer approach
limitations.note: The cleanup command caused the entire verification submission to be rejected before simulation, so the agent had to resubmit the same test with a different cleanup command.
